_doc: Exploration nodes for an expedition (3 per trip). Choices resolve in Career.explore_resolve; the same for every critter (roles are styles, never a handicap). kinds: forage (scrap+materials, small risk), study (the wild critter starts weaker), rest (heal), push (risky, bigger haul), shortcut (skip a node).

templates.title: Fresh tracks
templates.text: You find %s tracks crossing %s. Follow them, or look for supplies first?

choices.label: Study the tracks
choices.hint: The wild critter will start weaker

templates.title: An old structure
templates.text: Something was built here long ago, in %s. There may be materials, and something may still live in it.

templates.title: A quiet place
templates.text: The ground levels out and the noise drops. Your critter could rest here, or you could scout ahead.

choices.label: Scout ahead
choices.hint: The wild critter will start weaker

choices.label: Take the ridge
choices.hint: Skip the next stop, small risk

templates.title: The terrain turns
templates.text: %s shifts under your critter's feet. You can pick a safe line or cut straight through.

templates.title: Signs of a home
templates.text: Scraps, markings, a worn path: this species lives close by. You can take what it left, or watch it.

choices.label: Watch from cover
choices.hint: The wild critter will start weaker
